selection: equally spaced chronological row positions without reading human ratings
transcript_scope: Only cached ASR words wholly inside preceding44seconds; no full sentence-field leakage
human_scope_precedence: only identical person, media, quality, scope, start and stop
invalid_or_missing_evidence: abstain; no generated response repair or best-response selection
status: Frozen before the first ordinal pilot; no actual ordinal model outputs or held-out scores inspected. No threshold tuning based on outcomes.
previous_runs: Three freeform content-only runtime pilots produced no valid training labels; preserved unchanged
ordinal_options: A/B/C/D/E=0/2.5/5/7.5/10; X=insufficient evidence. Sum disjoint letter and space-letter token probabilities; exclude if X has greatest mass or six-option total mass<0.1. Otherwise normalize five rating options.
